mr_title: Rendered named choice groups with <optgroup> in FilteredSelectMultiple.
mr_description:
This patch adds support for <optgroup>s in FilteredSelectMultiple widgets.
When a popup returns a new object, if the source field contains optgroup
choices, the optgroup is now also included in the response data.

Additionally, this adds error handling for invalid source_model parameters
to prevent crashes and display user-friendly error messages instead.

expected_issues.title: KeyError when the popup source model is not registered in the admin site
expected_issues.description:
The popup response indexes admin_site._registry with a model taken from the request, raising KeyError (HTTP 500) when the source model is not registered with this admin site, e.g. for inline forms.

_source_model comes from POST data. apps.get_model() only proves the model exists, not that it has a ModelAdmin on this site. For related-object popups opened from an inline whose model is not registered, `self.admin_site._registry[source_model]` raises KeyError after the object has already been saved, so the user gets a server error. Use _registry.get() and skip the optgroup lookup when absent.
